description:
Read all feedback entries for an agent with optional tag filtering and pagination. Returns up to 20 entries per page. Pass nextCursor from the previous response to page. WARNING: Uses one RPC call per entry (N+1 pattern) — avoid calling for agents with large feedback sets without using cursor-based pagination. No wallet required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

agentId.description: Agent ID to read all feedback for

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (index to start from). Default 0.

includeRevoked.description: Include revoked feedback entries. Default false.

name: reputation_read_all_feedback
